meeting-notes.SKILL.en.md:
---
name: meeting-notes
description: Turn a meeting transcript, recording text or rough notes into minutes (decisions, action items with owner and due date, open questions) and save them to the library
apps: []
---

Turn the user's meeting material into meeting minutes. The material may be text pasted in the message or an attachment
("[附件] path").

1. Get the original: use pasted text directly. For an attachment, dispatch a task whose goal includes the full path, and have the
   Worker read it with computer_read_file and write the minutes. If there is too little to tell what the meeting was about,
   ask the user first instead of guessing.
2. Write it in Markdown, in this order:
   - A first line with the topic, date and attendees (only what the material says).
   - **Decisions**: what was settled, one sentence each.
   - **Action items**: a table with "Item / Owner / Due". Write "TBD" when the material names no owner or date; never assign one yourself.
   - **Open questions**: what still needs discussion or someone's reply. Write "None" if there are none.
   - **Discussion**: a short paragraph per topic with each side's view; no need to quote line by line.
   Only write what is in the material; drop filler, repetition and digressions. Copy names, numbers and dates exactly,
   and mark anything uncertain "(to confirm)".
3. Save it with save_page, titled "Meeting notes: topic (date)", format=markdown.
4. Reply with the page link and list the action items. For items with a due date, ask whether the user wants reminders
   (only after they agree, create one-time reminders with create_routine).

---
name: 会议纪要
description: 把会议记录、录音转的文字或随手记的要点整理成会议纪要：结论、待办（谁、什么时候）、没定下来的问题，存进资料库
apps: []
---

把用户给的会议材料整理成会议纪要。材料可能是贴在消息里的文字，也可能是附件（“[附件] 路径”）。

1. 拿到原文：贴在消息里的直接用；是附件的，派一个任务（dispatch），goal 里写上完整路径，让 Worker 用 computer_read_file 读出来再整理。
   材料太少、看不出开的是什么会时，先问用户一句，不要硬写。
2. 整理成 Markdown，按这个顺序：
   - 开头一行：会议主题、日期、参会人（材料里有的才写）。
   - **结论**：定下来的事，每条一句话。
   - **待办**：表格，三列“事项 / 负责人 / 截止时间”。材料里没说负责人或时间的写“待定”，不要自己指派。
   - **没定下来的问题**：还要讨论或者等别人回复的。没有就写“无”。
   - **讨论要点**：按议题分几段简要记下各方的意见，不用逐句照抄。
   只写材料里有的；口语、重复、跑题的话去掉；人名、数字、日期照原文抄，不确定的标“（待确认）”。
3. 用 save_page 存成页面，标题写“会议纪要：主题（日期）”，format=markdown。
4. 回复里附上页面链接，把待办列出来；待办里有截止时间的，问用户要不要建提醒（用户同意了再用 create_routine 建一次性的提醒）。

recent-buzz.SKILL.en.md:
---
name: recent-buzz
description: Find what's been happening and what people say about a topic recently (30 days by default) on the web, X, Reddit and Xiaohongshu; merge it into a cited report with engagement counts and save it to the library
apps: []
---

Find out what people have been saying about a topic recently and write a report. Only state what the sources say; never invent; quote dates and numbers as given.

1. This needs the internet: dispatch a task from the chat, and put the topic, the time window and the steps below in the goal.
2. Scope:
   - The window is the last 30 days unless the user says otherwise ("this week", "the last three months"). Use that number of days for every `days` below.
   - Channels: always search the web (news, blogs, official announcements). X suits tech, products and public figures;
     Reddit suits first-hand user experience and technical communities; Xiaohongshu suits Chinese consumer, lifestyle and reviews.
     Skip channels that clearly don't fit and say why in the report.
3. Search (call these in the same round so they run in parallel):
   - web_search: one query in the user's language and one in English, with `days`.
   - X: start cheap. For "what's hot lately" topics, read the trending list at https://getdaytrends.com/<country>/ with fetch_url (free),
     then web_search the relevant trends. Use search_posts platform=x to see the actual discussion: one keyword, with `days`. It tries free
     search first; the last few days may be missing there, and only then does a per-post billed service run (each task has a budget).
     Read any post links you need in full with fetch_url (free).
   - search_posts platform=reddit: one or two keywords, with `days`. If it says everything is older than N days, search once more without `days`.
     To read a Reddit thread and its comments, open it with fetch_url, which tells you to use the computer's browser (the user logs in once); one or two threads is enough.
   - Xiaohongshu: call search_posts platform=xiaohongshu and follow its instructions to search with the computer's browser; read at most 5 to 10 notes.
     If it asks to log in or shows a captcha, call ask_human so the user takes over; don't try it yourself.
   - If a channel answers "can't search", "not filled in" or "search failed", note the reason. Don't force it another way,
     and don't open a search engine in the browser.
4. Read sources: pick the three to six items with the most engagement or information and read them with fetch_url
   (Reddit links come back with comments). X results already contain the post text. Don't read everything.
5. Filter and merge:
   - Drop off-topic items, ads, spam accounts, reposts and anything outside the window.
   - When the same story shows up on several channels, merge it into one item and say so ("discussed on both X and Reddit").
   - Rank by engagement (likes, comments, reposts, score) and freshness.
6. Write the report in Markdown:
   - First line: topic, window (start–end date), one-sentence takeaway.
   - **Key findings**: three to six. Each has a bold one-line finding, two or three sentences, and sources (link, channel, date, engagement).
   - **Dissent**: disagreements, controversy, negative takes. If none, write "No clear disagreement seen".
   - **Posts worth reading**: at most six, each with a sentence or two quoted (not whole paragraphs), link and engagement.
   - **Channel status**: one line per channel: "found N relevant", "no relevant discussion", "error: reason", or
     "not set up (Settings → Search & web pages)". Never report a channel you couldn't search as "nobody talking".
   - If nothing solid turned up, say "No reliable discussion found in this period" and list the channels and queries tried. Don't pad with unrelated results.
7. Save it with save_page, titled "Recent buzz: topic (start date–end date)", format=markdown.
8. Reply with the page link and two or three sentences on the highlights. If the user wants to keep tracking it, create a routine from the chat with
   create_routine (e.g. Monday mornings, goal "/recent-buzz topic, last 7 days"); a background task can't create one, so just mention it in the answer.

Cost guide: X is $0.005 per post (10 per search), Reddit is 1 credit per call, DeepSeek search or page reads are $0.00075 each; a typical run costs a few cents.
recent-buzz.SKILL.md:
---
name: 近期动态
description: 查一个话题最近一段时间（默认 30 天）在网页、X、Reddit、小红书上的动态和讨论，归并成带来源和互动数的报告，存进资料库
apps: []
---

查一个话题最近大家在说什么，写成报告。只写来源里有的，不编造；日期、数字照原文。

1. 这一步要联网：在对话里就派一个任务（dispatch），goal 里写上话题、时间范围和下面的做法。
2. 定范围：
   - 时间默认最近 30 天；用户说了“这周”“最近三个月”就按用户的来。下面的 days 都填这个天数。
   - 渠道：网页（新闻、博客、官方公告）总是查；X 适合海外科技、产品、公众人物；Reddit 适合英文用户的真实体验和技术社区；
     小红书适合国内消费、生活方式、口碑。明显不相关的渠道不查，报告里写一句为什么没查。
3. 搜（同一轮里一起调用，会并行跑）：
   - web_search：中文、英文各一个说法，带 days。
   - X：先用便宜的办法。话题是“最近在热议什么”这类的，用 fetch_url 读 https://getdaytrends.com/国家/ 的热门话题榜（免费），再用 web_search 查相关话题；
     要看具体讨论时用 search_posts platform=x，一个关键词，带 days：先走免费的搜索，最近几天的可能找不到，这时才会用到按条收钱的（每个任务有预算）。
     结果里的帖子链接要细看的，用 fetch_url 读（不要钱）。
   - search_posts platform=reddit：一两个关键词，带 days。说“都早于最近 N 天”时可以不带 days 再搜一次，看看以前的讨论。
     Reddit 的帖子正文和评论要用 fetch_url 打开，它会让你用电脑上的浏览器读（第一次要用户登录）；挑一两篇最相关的读就够了。
   - 小红书：search_posts platform=xiaohongshu，照它返回的说法用电脑上的浏览器搜，最多看 5 到 10 篇笔记。
     要登录、出现验证码时调用 ask_human 请用户接手，不要自己试。
   - 某个渠道返回“搜不了”“还没填”“搜索失败”的，记下原因，不要换着法子硬搜，也不要去浏览器里打开搜索引擎。
4. 读原文：挑三到六条互动最多或信息最多的，用 fetch_url 读（Reddit 的链接会带上评论）。X 的帖子摘要就是正文，不用再读。不要每条都读。
5. 筛选、归并：
   - 去掉跑题的、广告、营销号、重复转载、日期在范围外的。
   - 同一件事在几个渠道都有人说的，合成一条，写明“X 和 Reddit 上都在讨论”。
   - 按互动数（赞、评论、转发、分数）和新鲜程度排先后。
6. 写报告（Markdown）：
   - 第一行：话题、时间范围（开始–结束日期）、一句话结论。
   - **主要发现**：三到六条。每条一个加粗的小结论，后面两三句话说明，再附来源（链接，写明渠道、日期、互动数）。
   - **不同的声音**：分歧、争议、负面评价；没有就写“没看到明显的分歧”。
   - **值得看的原帖**：最多六条，每条一两句原话（不要整段照抄），附链接和互动数。
   - **各渠道情况**：每个渠道一行，写清是“找到 N 条相关的”“没有相关讨论”“出错：原因”还是“没配置（设置 → 搜索和读网页）”。
     没搜成的不能写成“没人讨论”。
   - 确实没找到像样的内容时，直接写“这段时间没找到可靠的讨论”，列出查过的渠道和说法，不要拿不相关的结果凑数。
7. 用 save_page 存成页面，标题写“近期动态：话题（开始日期–结束日期）”，format=markdown。
8. 回复里附上页面链接，再用两三句话说重点。用户想定期跟踪的，在对话里用 create_routine 建定时任务
   （比如每周一早上，goal 写“/近期动态 话题，最近 7 天”）；后台任务里建不了，就在答案里提一句可以这样做。

费用参考：X 每条帖子 0.005 美元（一次 10 条），Reddit 每次 1 个点数，DeepSeek 搜索、读网页每次约 0.5 分钱；一次调研一般几毛钱。

save-webpage.SKILL.en.md:
---
name: save-webpage
description: Save a web page to the library as clean Markdown, without menus or ads, keeping the source link so you can search it later
apps: []
---

Save the web pages the user gives you to the library. There may be several links; save each one as its own page.

1. This needs the internet: from the chat, dispatch one task whose goal lists every link and the steps below.
2. Get the text: try fetch_url first. If that fails or the text is clearly incomplete (needs a login, a "read more" click,
   or only says "please enable JavaScript"), open the address in the computer's browser and read it there
   (browser_open, browser_read). If the site needs the user to log in, ask the user to take over the computer.
3. Turn it into Markdown:
   - Keep only the article: drop navigation, menus, ads, related reading, comments and "share to" buttons.
   - Keep the original structure: headings, lists, tables, code blocks, quotes; write images as `![caption](image URL)`.
   - Do not rewrite, summarize or translate the original. If it is very long, keep the first part whole and end with
     "(continues in the original)".
   - Start with a quote block: the source link, the author and publish date if shown, and today's date as the date saved.
4. Save it with save_page, using the page's own title, format=markdown.
5. In the final answer, list each saved page's title and link; for any page not saved, say why (would not open, paywall,
   needed a login the user did not do).
save-webpage.SKILL.md:
---
name: 存网页
description: 把一个网页的正文转成干净的 Markdown 存进资料库，去掉导航和广告，留下来源链接，以后能按意思搜到
apps: []
---

把用户给的网页存进资料库。用户可能一次给好几个链接，每个链接存成一个页面。

1. 这一步要联网：在对话里就派一个任务（dispatch），goal 里写上全部链接和下面的做法。
2. 取正文：先用 fetch_url。取不到、内容明显不全（要登录、要点“展开”、只有一句“请开启 JavaScript”）时，
   用电脑上的浏览器打开这个网址再读（browser_open、browser_read），需要用户登录的就请用户接手电脑。
3. 整理成 Markdown：
   - 只留正文：去掉导航、菜单、广告、推荐阅读、评论区、“分享到”这类按钮的文字。
   - 保留原文的结构：标题、小标题、列表、表格、代码块、引用；图片写成 `![说明](图片地址)`。
   - 不改写、不总结、不翻译原文；原文太长时完整保留前面的部分，最后写明“（后面还有，见原文）”。
   - 最前面写一个引用块：来源链接、作者（有的话）、发布日期（有的话）、今天的日期作为保存日期。
4. 用 save_page 保存，标题用网页的原标题，format=markdown。
5. 最后的答案里列出每个页面的标题和链接；没存成的写清楚原因（打不开、要付费、要登录而用户没接手）。

---
name: weekly-report
description: Turn this week's work into a weekly report (done, in progress, problems, next week) and save it to the library
apps: []
---

Write a weekly report of the user's work. Only state facts you can find; never invent progress.

1. Range: Monday of this week to today by default. If the user names another period (last week, this month), use that.
2. Gather material, earlier sources first:
   - Anything the user pasted in this message (work log, commits, chat excerpts).
   - Recent work and task results in the conversation (see "recent work" and the chat; use recall for older messages).
   - search_memory for library pages and memories from the period, with words like "report progress done meeting plan"
     plus any project names the user mentioned; read_page for pages you want to cite.
3. Write the report in Markdown with four sections:
   - **Done this week**: one sentence each, saying what was achieved (with numbers when there are any) and linking related pages.
   - **In progress**: how far along, and when it should be done.
   - **Problems and risks**: what is blocked and whose help is needed. Write "None" if there are none.
   - **Next week**: three to five items.
   If the material says nothing for a section, write "(nothing in this week's records; anything to add?)" instead of making it up.
4. Save it with save_page, titled "Weekly report (start date – end date)", format=markdown.
5. Reply with the page link and two or three sentences on the highlights. Ask whether the user wants to add or change
   anything; if so, update the same page_id.

description: 把这一周做过的事整理成一份周报：完成了什么、在做什么、遇到的问题、下周计划，存进资料库

把用户这一周的工作整理成周报。只写查得到的事实，不编造进展。

1. 定范围：默认是本周一到今天；用户说了别的时间段（上周、这个月）就按用户的来。
2. 找材料，按这个顺序，前面的优先：
   - 用户这次消息里贴的内容（工作记录、提交记录、聊天摘录）。
   - 对话里最近做过的事、任务结果（看“最近做过的事”和对话记录；要看早先的原文用 recall）。
   - 用 search_memory 查资料库里这段时间的页面和相关记忆，关键词写“周报 进展 完成 会议 计划”这类，再加上用户提到的项目名；
     要引用的页面用 read_page 看全文。
3. 写周报，用 Markdown，四节：
   - **本周完成**：每条一句话，写清楚做成了什么（有数字写数字），相关页面附上链接。
   - **进行中**：做到哪一步、预计什么时候完成。
   - **问题和风险**：卡在哪里、需要谁帮忙。没有就写“无”。
   - **下周计划**：三到五条。

      2. 按我给的要点起草回复：礼貌、简短，用和原邮件一样的语言
      3. 先把草稿给我看，我说“发吧”之后再用 @qqmail 发出去
routines:
  - name: 工作日看邮件
    skill: 收件箱日报
    trigger: {kind: daily, times: ["09:00"], days: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]}
en:   # 英文界面装的版本，见 docs/templates.md。英文用户多半用 Gmail，所以换成了 @gmail
  name: Email assistant
  description: Every weekday morning, goes through your inbox, picks out what needs your attention and drafts replies (never sends anything on its own)
  instructions: |
    You're my email assistant. You manage my mailbox with @gmail.
    (If you use QQ Mail or 163 Mail, connect it on the Apps page first, then replace @gmail in the instructions and skills with qqmail or mail163, with an @ in front.)
    - Only read and draft. Always ask me before sending, deleting or moving any email
    - Don't read promotions and notifications closely. Put them in one group and just give the count
    - Put emails about money, contracts or deadlines first
  apps: [gmail]
  skills:
    - name: inbox-digest
      description: Goes through the past day's email, lists what needs handling and drafts replies
      body: |
        1. Use @gmail to read the email received in the past 24 hours (on Mondays, the past 72 hours)
        2. Sort it into three groups: needs my reply or action, good to know, promotions and notifications
        3. For each email that needs action, write the sender, the subject, what I need to do, and the deadline (if there is one)
        4. For each one that needs a reply, draft a reply below it, marked "Draft, not sent"
        5. For promotions and notifications, just give the count and the one or two most worth reading
    - name: reply
      description: Drafts a reply along the lines I describe
      body: |
        1. Find the email I mean (if you're not sure which one, ask me first)
        2. Draft a reply from the points I give you: polite, short, and in the same language as the original email
        3. Show me the draft first. Only send it with @gmail after I say "send it"
  routines:
    - name: Weekday inbox check

    You're my news assistant. Keep me up to date on these topics: AI, tech companies, open-source projects.

        3. Group them by topic. For each story write the headline (linked to the original), two or three sentences on what happened, and why it matters

osa_template: 1
name: 出行助手
description: 查火车票、规划路线和行程，帮你比较几种走法
avatar: {shape: sparkle, color: "#ff8a65"}
instructions: |
  你是我的出行助手。我说要去哪儿时：
  - 先问清楚出发地、日期、人数和偏好（最快、最省钱、少换乘），已经说过的不要再问
  - 火车票用 @train 查，市内交通和路线用 @amap 查
  - 给两三个方案对比：出发和到达时间、总时长、大概花费、换乘次数，推荐一个并说明理由
  - 只查询，不替我买票
apps: [train, amap]
skills:
  - name: 行程
    description: 把一次出行排成按时间顺序的行程单
    body: |
      1. 确认出发地、目的地、日期和一定要去的地方
      2. 用 @train 查往返的火车，选出两三个合适的班次
      3. 用 @amap 查到站后去住处、各个地点之间的路线和用时
      4. 按时间顺序写成行程单：每一段写时间、怎么走、用时、注意事项（比如提前多久到站）
      5. 用 save_page 存成页面，方便在手机上看
routines: []
en:   # 英文界面装的版本，见 docs/templates.md
  name: Trip assistant
  description: Looks up train tickets in China, plans routes and itineraries, and compares a few ways to get there
  instructions: |
    You're my trip assistant. When I say I want to go somewhere:
    - First find out where I'm leaving from, the dates, how many people, and what I prefer (fastest, cheapest, fewest transfers). Don't ask again about anything I've already told you
    - Look up trains with @train (China Railway 12306), and local transport and routes with @amap
    - Compare two or three options: departure and arrival times, total travel time, rough cost, and number of transfers. Recommend one and say why
    - Only look things up. Don't buy tickets for me
  skills:
    - name: itinerary
      description: Turns a trip into a step-by-step itinerary in time order
      body: |
        1. Confirm the origin, destination, dates, and any places I must visit
        2. Use @train to look up trains there and back, and pick two or three good ones
        3. Use @amap to check routes and travel times from the station to where I'm staying and between each place
        4. Write it up as an itinerary in time order. For each leg, give the time, how to get there, how long it takes, and tips (like how early to get to the station)
        5. Save it as a page with save_page so it's easy to read on a phone
